title: rest(export): a schema-derived CSV export carries an empty "Search Index" column, because the export column set does not skip the hidden `__search` search companion
body:
Filing gate: ① a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a measured reach. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-sales` · `session_016PVjjuVPte5XEJvaQx1E4t`, from the out-of-scope findings of #24036 half B (PR #24141).

- **Reader:** the `domain:cli` seat, in `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, at the export handler's schema-derived column set (the `fieldsFromSchema` path).
- **Dedupe:** `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack for "internal __search field exposed Search Index column CSV export object designer" gave 2 hits, both closed, and neither covers the export header:
  - #7642, the `__search` value echoed in record bodies;
  - #4483, `$search` auto-fields hitting the primary key.

### Reach

The half-B dev measured this once on a dev boot of `examples/app-showcase`, built from #24141's tree (`main` `27d7c2aa1` plus ledger-only edits):
- `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/export?format=csv` with no `fields` answers a header row with a **`Search Index`** column, empty on every row.

### Why

- `packages/objectql/src/search-companion.ts` `provisionSearchCompanion` declares the `__search` column with `label: 'Search Index'` and `hidden: true`, plus `system`, `readonly` and `searchable: false`.
- The export handler in `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` builds its default columns from the object schema read through `getMetaItem`. It narrows them to the FLS-readable set (#3391, #3547), but nothing in that file reads a field's `hidden` flag, so the companion survives into the header.
- The data reads already strip the companion (`stripSearchCompanionFromRead`), so the export is the one default projection that disagrees with the list.

### Done when

- A schema-derived export (no `?fields=`) has no column for a `hidden` field, `__search` included.
- An explicit `?fields=` request stays as it is today.
- A test pins both, and an ablation shows the test fails when the filter is removed.

### Not in this card

- The same run saw the console list `Search Index __search` as a Text field on the object designer canvas, and the permission matrix list `showcase_account.__search` as readable and editable. Those are renderers in objectstack-ai/objectui that show a `hidden` field the meta read serves on purpose. Triage decides whether objectui gets its own card.
